policy: Byte-preserved UTF-8 text receipts and authored replay fixtures with exact original mapping and SHA256; no normalization. Candidate build logs mapped to build-receipts so source exclusion of build directories does not drop receipts. Frozen old library copies intentionally preserve differential inputs. Historical statuses/failures remain historical. Generated assembly/binaries/archives/cache and sentinel binary products remain external. No downloaded reference extracts, secrets or rejected carrier helpers included. Copied script receipts use 0644 distribution mode.
